_comment: Nested object schemas referenced from fields.json's "ref". Sourced from https://hh-specs.handhistory.org/ per-object pages (spec_version 1.4.9, fetched 2026-11-04). Same global requiredness rule as fields.json: required unless a stated exception appears in notes. Not cross-checked against a second implementation, see

player_obj.doc: One of the players seated at the table when the hand was dealt.

id.doc: This player's id, referenced by player_id elsewhere in the hand (e.g. hero_player_id, action_obj.player_id, dealer_seat is a seat number, not this id).

seat.doc: The seat number this player occupied.

display.doc: An alternate display name. Not present in the only example fetched so far; requiredness unconfirmed.

starting_stack.doc: The player's stack size at the start of the hand.

player_bounty.doc: The player's bounty value, for bounty tournaments (0 otherwise).

is_sitting_out.doc: Whether the player was sitting out. Not present in the only example fetched so far; requiredness unconfirmed.

round_obj.doc: One betting round (street) of the hand.

id.doc: The round's order within the hand. Authoritative for ordering, street names are not unique (run-it-twice hands repeat a street name across two rounds).

street.doc: The street this round represents. See registry enums.json#street.

cards.doc: Community cards dealt on this round. The one example fetched shows this present-but-empty ([]) on Preflop and absent entirely on Showdown, both appear valid; requiredness/nullability is not explicitly stated and should be treated as 'present when cards exist for this street, may be omitted otherwise' pending a second example.

actions.doc: The actions taken during this round, in order.

action_obj.doc: One action taken during a round.

action_number.doc: The action's order, scoped to its round (resets each round, per the example: round 4/Showdown restarts at 1).

player_id.doc: The player who took this action. Explicitly nullable/omittable when the action is not related to a specific player (stated exception: the 'Add to Pot' action).

action.doc: The action taken. See registry enums.json#action.

description.doc: A free-text description of the action. Not present in the only example fetched so far; requiredness unconfirmed.

amount.doc: The amount associated with this action (0 for actions with no amount, e.g. Fold/Check). Can be negative for 'Player Adjustment'.

is_allin.doc: Whether this action put the player all-in.

cards.doc: Cards revealed by this action. Present only on card-revealing actions (Dealt Cards, Shows Cards) in the example fetched; absent on others.

pot_obj.doc: One pot awarded at the end of the hand.

number.doc: This pot's index (0 for the main pot, 1+ for side pots).

amount.doc: The total amount in this pot.

rake.doc: The rake taken from this pot.

jackpot.doc: Any jackpot contribution taken from this pot. Not present in the only example fetched so far; requiredness unconfirmed.

player_wins.doc: The players who won (a share of) this pot.

player_wins_obj.doc: One player's win from a pot.

win_amount.doc: The amount this player won from the pot.

cashout_amount.doc: The amount cashed out, if the site supports early cashout.

cashout_fee.doc: The fee taken for an early cashout.

bonus_amount.doc: Any bonus amount awarded. Not present in the only example fetched so far; requiredness unconfirmed.

contributed_rake.doc: This player's share of the rake taken. Not present in the only example fetched so far; requiredness unconfirmed.

tournament_info_obj.doc: Tournament metadata, present when the hand's tournament field is true.

tournament_number.doc: The site's own identifier for the tournament.

bounty_fee_amount.doc: The bounty portion of the fee, for bounty tournaments.

initial_stack.doc: The starting chip stack for this tournament.

type.doc: The tournament type/format. No enum list confirmed yet (not fully fetched); treat as free-text pending confirmation.

flags.doc: Tournament-level flags. Explicitly nullable/omittable per the spec, see registry enums.json#tournament_flags.

speed_obj.doc: A tournament's speed/blind-level settings. Field list from the spec's index only, not independently fetched/confirmed yet .

type.doc: The speed category (e.g. regular/turbo/hyper-turbo). Exact enum values not yet confirmed.

round_time.doc: The duration of each blind level, in seconds (unit not independently confirmed).

tournament_bounty_obj.doc: A bounty awarded during the hand, for bounty tournaments.

player_id.doc: The player who collected the bounty.

defeated_player_id.doc: The player who was eliminated to award this bounty.

bet_type.doc: No Limit / Pot Limit / Fixed Limit. See registry enums.json#bet_type.

bet_cap.doc: The maximum bet size, for Cap games (0 when uncapped).
